description: This PHP source file contains a test class EmployeeAPITest which tests the EmployeeAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods to test retrieving employee pictures, fetching one or all employees, creating, updating, and deleting employee records, along with associated data providers. The class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and uses mock services for testing API endpoints.
